_comment: 5类占位符的prompt模板。{description}会被替换为占位符文本框里的原始描述。所有prompt强制no text/no numbers避免GPT image 2乱编文字。

mechanism_diagram.prompt: Flat medical schematic illustration of: {description}. Style requirements: scientific vector aesthetic, clean line work, labeled arrows showing causal/signaling flow between elements, isometric or 3/4 perspective for organs and cells, color palette dominated by deep purple #6B2C8C with secondary lavender #A55EA0 and one accent color, white background, no shadows, no 3D rendering effects, BioRender-inspired educational style. CRITICAL: do not render any text, letters, numbers, or labels in the image. All annotations will be added externally. Anatomical positions must be correct (heart on left, liver on right under diaphragm).

data_chart_mockup.prompt: Stylized scientific data visualization mockup illustrating: {description}. Style: flat publication-quality chart aesthetic, bars/lines/scatter points rendered in #6B2C8C primary and #A55EA0 secondary with one #FFA94D accent if needed, clean white background, minimal gridlines or no gridlines, axes shown as thin black lines. CRITICAL: do NOT render any numerical values, axis tick labels, data labels, legend text, or any letters/numbers in the image. The chart should be visually suggestive of the described data pattern but contain zero text. All numerical content will be overlaid externally.

anatomical_organ.prompt: Stylized anatomical illustration of: {description}. Style: flat medical art, isometric or 3/4 view, cross-section if relevant showing internal architecture, color palette #6B2C8C primary with anatomically appropriate secondary tones (red for blood vessels, pink for muscle tissue), white background, educational textbook quality, clean vector line work. CRITICAL: no text labels, no annotations, no leader lines pointing to structures. Anatomical accuracy is essential.

experiment_concept.prompt: Conceptual illustration of laboratory workflow for: {description}. Style: flat icon-based aesthetic, simplified equipment representation (no photorealistic detail), color palette #6B2C8C and #A55EA0 on white background, suitable as section header decoration. Show sample flow with thin arrows between simplified equipment icons (centrifuge, plate, microscope as abstract shapes). CRITICAL: no text labels on equipment, no specific data values shown, no legible writing anywhere in the image.

infographic.prompt: Flat modern infographic illustration of: {description}. Style: clean editorial design, isometric elements where appropriate, color palette #6B2C8C primary, #A55EA0 secondary, #FFA94D accent on white background, suitable for academic presentation. Visual elements may include simplified maps, flow diagrams, timeline elements. CRITICAL: minimize all text in the image, no specific numerical values, no detailed labels, no place names or proper nouns rendered as text.
